positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Joined the Remote Online Notary team as an Engineering Manager. In my time on the team, I worked to push through an employee promotion, onboarded a new SDET to my team, and led the development of a new feature that integrated with 3 other teams across the organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined the DocuSign Transaction Rooms team. Contributed to a full-stack solution using C#, Angular, React, and SQL. Helped lead an architecture change across the solution to speed up API response times, improve developer testing efforts, and ease new developer onboarding time.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer I
positions.description: Began introducing developer-testing (unit testing and integration testing) for a legacy Windows desktop application. Led developer presentations to introduce the concepts and show examples.

positions.description:
Work as part of a scrum team developing perinatal applications using technologies including
- C#
- WPF
- WebAPI

positions.description: I joined the Clinical Diagnostics Group

positions.title: Lead Engineer, Application Development
positions.description: I work in the perinatal group at GE Healthcare.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fixed defects near the end of a release cycle for an existing WPF application.
Created designs for new features in next release of product.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
While at AgileTek, I worked on developing operator interface software for a medical device using C#, XAML, WPF, and WCF.  Our work was done following Test Driven Development, and it was done in a regulated environment.

I also contributed to an internal project which sought to establish a quality system within AgileTek which would satisfy the criteria for regulated development.

positions.title: none
positions.description:
Performed project management duties including subcontractor coordination, project scheduling, and on-site supervision.
•	Performed troubleshooting and implemented requested improvements in company’s line-of-business application written in Visual Basic 6.
•	Worked through the night on several occasions to meet compressed deadlines.
•	Researched alternatives to company’s paper timecard system.  Presented findings to president and led team to implement the chosen alternative.

positions.title: Freelance Consultant
positions.description:
Developed custom business software for customers in various industries.  Worked in all phases of software life cycle—requirements elicitation through post-installation support.
•	Developed software using Visual Basic 6 (using COM+ architecture), Microsoft Excel with VBA, Microsoft Access, SQL among others.
•	Developed bidding software for a landscape contractor.
•	Created order management software for a mail order company.
•	Developed insurance policy rating and tracking software for an insurance company.

volunteerExperiences.description: I serve as a mentor to two teams in FIRST FTC (Teams 12043 and 13377), helping teach basic programming concepts and debugging to drive a robot both autonomously as well as driver-controlled to accomplish a defined goal.
